text: Ship a Codex-focused six-tool QuietContext runtime with hard MCP token budgets.
Docs first; then root-cause-driven TDD; preserve raw data in sandbox or FTS5.
Keep only context-saving capability while eliminating plugin-generated token cost and narration.
